steps.headline: Should the four-kinds rule go in the guide for every Settings popup?
steps.today: Settings popups mix up to 12 kinds of box: wrapper cards, cards inside cards, icon cards, chip tabs, tables.
steps.problem: Each screen looks busy and different from the next, even after the earlier fixes.
steps.proposal: A Settings popup uses only a small label, a row, a notice box and buttons; grids of things you install may still use cards.

options.label: Yes, make it the rule
pros: Every Settings popup looks calm and alike.
New screens have a clear recipe.
cons: Some screens lose visual grouping they had.

options.label: Only for some screens
pros: Keeps boxes where you liked them.
cons: The guide needs exceptions; screens drift again.
